behavior_constraints: scale <env> <service> <count> sets replicas; validates in order: env exists → service exists → valid positive integer → deployed → env max_replicas → service bounds; prints SCALED <env>/<service> to <count> replicas (was <previous>)

scale <env> <service> <count> errors: unknown environment '<env>', unknown service '<service>', invalid replica count '<count>', <service> is not deployed to <env>, <count> exceeds max_replicas (<max>) for <env>, <count> violates bounds [<min>..<max>] for <service> in <env>
scale <env> <service> (no count) prints '<service>: <count> replicas' with default 1 for deployed-but-never-scaled services; errors '<service> is not deployed to <env>' if not deployed
scale <env> lists all deployed services alphabetically as '<service>: <count> replicas'; prints nothing if none deployed; errors 'unknown environment <env>' if env missing

scale <env> --all <count> validates all deployed services first; reports first alphabetical bounds violation as 'ERROR: <count> violates bounds [<min>..<max>] for <service> in <env>'; on success prints SCALED line per service alphabetically then 'Scaled <N> services to <count> replicas'; writes SCALE event per service; errors 'ERROR: no services deployed in <env>' if none; lock-enforced

scale <env> <service> --bounds <min> <max> requires min>=1, max>=min, max<=env max_replicas; prints 'BOUNDS <env>/<service> set to [<min>..<max>]'; auto-adjusts current replicas outside new bounds and prints 'SCALED <env>/<service> to <adjusted> replicas (was <previous>)' plus SCALE event; errors 'invalid bounds: min must be >= 1', 'invalid bounds: max must be >= min', 'invalid bounds: max (<max>) exceeds max_replicas (<env_max>) for <env>'; lock-enforced
scale <env> <service> --bounds (read) prints '<service>: bounds [<min>..<max>]' or '<service>: no bounds set'; service must be deployed
write operations (scale set, --all, --bounds set) are blocked on locked environments; read operations (list, get, get-bounds) work on locked environments
each SCALE event is JSON: {timestamp, iso_timestamp, action:'SCALE', service, version:'-', replicas, previous}; history displays '<iso_timestamp> SCALE <service> from <previous> to <count> replicas'
status <env> detail line shows '<service>: <version> (deployed at <timestamp>) [<count> replicas]' with default 1 for never-scaled services
entities.summary: Add a scale command (set/get/list/all/bounds) with persistent replica and bounds state, SCALE event logging, status integration showing replica counts, and deploy/rollback/promote interactions that reset replicas to 1 while preserving bounds.

instruction_head:
Add service replica scaling to the pipeline orchestrator. Replicas represent the number of instances running for each service in each environment.

**`pipeline.sh scale <environment> <service> <count>`** — Set the replica count for a service in an environment. Count must be a positive integer (>= 1). Output: `SCALED <env>/<service> to <count> replicas (was <previous>)`. Error if count exceeds the environment's `max_replicas` from the manifest: `ERROR: <count> exceeds max_replicas (<max>) for <en
